title: Designing Public Information for Strategic Advice
abstract: arXiv:2611.07744v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A principal chooses an action using advice from an expert who privately knows local conditions. Before receiving advice, she can commission a public study of an independent state, such as future demand, that changes the expected conflict between their preferred actions. We show that the communication protocol determines the optimal study. Under optimal mediation, the value of advice is convex in conflict, making full revelation optimal. Under commitment to an action rule, the principal may prefer no information, while informative optimal studies include a report certifying high conflict. Under unmediated cheap talk, changes in the number of equilibrium messages create upward kinks in the value of advice. Optimal studies avoid interior communication thresholds and can induce two distant communication regimes while skipping every regime in between, strictly outperforming both full revelation and no information. translated_title: 为战略建议设计公共信息
translated_abstract: 委托人需要依据一位私下了解当地情况的专家的建议来选择行动。在收到建议之前，她可以委托开展一项针对独立状态（例如未来需求）的公共研究，该研究改变了双方各自偏好行动之间的预期冲突程度。我们证明，沟通协议决定了最优研究的设计。在最优调解机制下，建议的价值关于冲突程度是凸的，因此完全披露是最优的。在承诺行动规则的情况下，委托人可能偏好不获取任何信息，而信息性的最优研究则包括一份证明高冲突的报告。在无调解的空谈（cheap talk）机制下，均衡信息数量的变化会在建议价值函数上产生向上的折点。最优研究会避免内部的沟通阈值，并且可以诱导两个相距遥远的沟通区间，同时跳过中间的所有区间，从而严格优于完全披露和不披露信息这两种极端做法。当委托人保留……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明公共信息的最优设计取决于沟通协议——在最优调解下完全披露最优，而在行动规则承诺或空谈机制下，最优研究可通过诱导跳跃式的沟通区间严格优于完全披露和完全不披露。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the optimal design of public information depends on the communication protocol: full revelation is optimal under mediation, while under action-rule commitment or cheap talk, optimal studies can induce distant communication regimes and strictly outperform both full revelation and no information.
